description: Variation of condition 1 of planning permission dated 14th May 2025 (RN:24/08966/FULL) for the Erection of new mansard roof extension to building in connection with change of use of upper levels from restaurant (Use Class E(b)) to 2x1-bed flats and 1x2-bed maisonette (Use Class C3). Alterations to facade including replacement of single glazed windows with timber-framed slimline double-glazed windows at 1 Lower John Street. Increase height of chimney stack to boundary shared with 1 Lower John Street at 2 Lower John Street. Namely, amendments to the elevations to include air bricks and to retain the single soil vent to facilitate internal services arrangements (Application under section 73 of the Act)
